mainText: <speak><voice name="Matthew">Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies and a temperature of 72 degrees at Verona City Hall, under the light of a full moon.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">The city is inviting everyone to participate in the I Voted sticker design contest. Students from grades K through 12 submitted 53 creative designs, and now the community can vote online or at City Hall through August 7 to select the four winning designs for our November election.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kendra">There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">Looking at the police report from July 20 to July 27, officers handled various calls. Notably, on July 26, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">The Culver's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. While they are currently closed, you can stop by when they open their doors at 10 AM today. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, they will be serving Caramel Peanut Buttercup.</voice></speak>
